description: This implementation uses the MLCommons Storage v2.0 reference code with Alluxio 3.6.0 mounted in FUSE mode pointing to AWS S3.System config: 1 clients, 2 servers, 1 total accelerators. No code modifications were made to the MLPerf scripts.
